mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.2% signals an aggressive monetary easing policy during a financial crisis, which reduces the risk-free rate and increases the present value of future equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.2%, with a t-test p-value > 0.05 against zero mean return.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 9.5% over three consecutive months signals improving labor market conditions, which increases consumer confidence and spending, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 9.5% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both residential investment (HOUST) and personal consumption (RSAFS) signals a broad-based recovery in private demand, which boosts corporate revenues and earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC between the interaction term and SPX returns is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below 85.0 for two consecutive months indicates a severe supply-side shock, which triggers risk-off sentiment and reduces equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the t-test p-value against zero mean return exceeds 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in real GDP (GDPC1) from a trough below 12,000 billion to above 13,000 billion in a single quarter signals a structural recovery in aggregate demand, which increases corporate profitability and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases from <12000 to >13000 in one quarter
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 crosses from below 12,000 to above 13,000 in a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in CPIAUCSL above 215.0 for two consecutive months signals accelerating inflation, which increases the likelihood of future monetary tightening, leading to higher discount rates and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 215.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) and a rise in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strong labor market recovery, which increases consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining UNRATE and rising PAYEMS fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 50% of cases, or the interaction term has a Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 85.0 combined with a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 580.0 signals a dual supply-side and demand-side contraction, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative in more than 60% of instances where both INDPRO < 85.0 and HOUST < 580.0.
